description: This file contains unit tests for the AssistantTextParser class/module, verifying its ability to parse and categorize text segments based on specific tags such as <think> and <final>.

classes.name: AssistantTextParserTests
classes.description: Test suite for the AssistantTextParser class, containing multiple test cases to validate parsing functionality.

methods.name: splitsThinkAndFinalSegments
methods.description: Tests that the parser correctly identifies and segments <think> and <final> tags.

methods.name: keepsTextWithoutTags
methods.description: Ensures that plain text without tags is treated as a single response segment.

methods.name: ignoresThinkingLikeTags
methods.description: Verifies that tags similar to <thinking> but not exact are ignored correctly.

methods.name: dropsEmptyTaggedContent
methods.description: Checks that empty tags like <think></think> are ignored and result in no segments.

methods.name: hidesThinkingSegmentsFromVisibleOutput
methods.description: Ensures that segments marked as thinking are hidden from visible output unless explicitly included.

methods.name: thinkingOnlyTextIsNotVisibleByDefault
methods.description: Validates that only text outside <think> tags is visible by default, unless includeThinking is true.
